# DRL-002: Enable Actions and repository security features

## Metadata

- Milestone: M1
- Labels: `ci`, `security`
- Owning mission: 00 / 01
- Evidence owner: Program Director
- Requirement IDs: `DRL-SEC-006`, `DRL-PLT-002`, `DRL-OPS-002`
- Dependencies: DRL-001
- Director decisions: none to implement CI; DIR-003 for public security contact later
- Public contract impact: NONE

## User / research value

Unsafe merges cannot silently land. Dependabot and secret scanning reduce supply-chain and credential risk.

## Controlling documents

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- `SECURITY.md`
- `docs/00-program/FIRST_SPRINT_PLAN.md`

## Scope

### In scope

- Confirm Actions can run `foundation-ci`
- Enable Dependabot (config present), secret scanning, and push protection if available on the plan
- Make CI a required check on protected branches when GitHub permissions allow

### Out of scope

- Expanding CI to full GPU/model jobs
- Changing application runtime code

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A workflow run on this repo is green or failures are filed with owners
- [ ] Dependabot config active
- [ ] Secret scanning / push protection status recorded
- [ ] Required checks documented even if org permissions delay enforcement

## Verification plan

```bash
gh workflow list
gh run list --limit 5
gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/vulnerability-alerts || true
```

## Security / privacy / licensing / cost

CI must not print secrets. Actions use `contents: read` as baseline. Cost: Actions minutes.

## Rollback

Disable required checks; keep workflow file in repo.

## Evidence required for closure

Workflow run URL, security settings notes, WORKLOG update.
